summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on providing data scientists with database access. Initially, [p1] inquired about a dedicated login/password for PostgreSQL. [me] confirmed that there is an existing read-only (r/o) login, but noted that individual credentials were not set up.

Later, [p1] asked if ClickHouse allowed access with an empty user. [me] stated that it should be possible in read-only mode but needed to verify if the r/o setting was enabled.
decisions: The existing PostgreSQL login is for read-only (r/o) access.
action_items: Someone needs to check and confirm if read-only permissions are properly enabled for ClickHouse.
